blurb: The club encourages equestrian activities and hosts horse shows, clinics, and private events. Members have access to arenas, grounds, clubhouse, and picnic areas. The club has a long history since 1956 and offers various member events and discounts.
extraNote: Membership requires a $350 one-time application fee · Speed limit on club grounds is 8 mph; 20 mph on nearby roads · 85 East Garzas Road, Carmel Valley, CA
